spans.s: 1. म the labial nasal.
2. म m. (in prosody) a molossus.
3. म base of the 1st pers. pron. in acc. sg. मा॑म् or मा
instr. म॑या
dat. म॑ह्यम् or मे
abl. म॑त् or म॑द्
gen. म॑म or मे (for the enclitic forms, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 22 &c.)

etym.s: [cf. s. म॑द्; Zd. ma; Gk. ἐ-μέ, μέ, Lat. me, mihi &c.]

spans.s: 4. म (connected with √ 3. मा) m. time, L.
poison, L.
a magic formula, L.
(in music) N. of the 4th note of the scale (abbreviated for मध्यम)
the moon, L.
N. of various gods (of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Yama), L.
happiness, welfare, L.
water, L.
a mother, L.
measure, L.
authority (-त्व n.), Nyāyam.
light, L.
knowledge, L.
binding, fettering, L.
death, L.
a woman's waist, L.
1. मा॑ ind. (causing a following छ् to be changed to च्छ्, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 74) not, that not, lest, would that not, RV. &c. &c.

or with the Impv. (in RV. only viii, 103, 6, मा नो हृणीताम् [SV. हृणीतास्] अग्निः॑, may Agni not be angry with us; but very often in later language, e.g. मा क्रन्द do not cry, MBh.; गच्छ वा मा वा, you can go or not go, ib.; रिपुर् अयम् मा जायताम्, may not this foe arise, Śāntiś.; also with स्म, e.g. मा स्म किं चिद् वचो वद do not speak a word, MBh.)
or with the Pot. (e.g. मा यमम् पश्येयम्, may I not see Yama; esp. माभुजेम in RV.)
or with the Prec. (only once in मा भूयात्, may it not be, R. [B.] ii, 75, 45)
or sometimes with the fut. (= that not, lest, e.g. मा त्वां शप्स्ये, lest I curse thee, MBh. cf. Vop. xxv, 27)

or with a participle (e.g. मा जीवन्यो दुःखदग्धो जीवति, he ought not to live who lives consumed by pain, Pañcat.; गतः स मा, he cannot have gone, Kathās.; मईवम्प्रार्थ्यम्, it must not be so requested, BhP.)
sometimes for the simple negative न (e.g. कथम् मा भूत्, how may it not be, Kathās.; मा गन्तुम् अर्हसि, thou oughtest not to go, R.; मा भूद् आगतः, can he not i.e. surely he must have arrived, Amar.)

occasionally without a verb (e. g. मा शब्दः or शब्दम्, do not make a noise, Hariv.; मा नाम रक्षिणः, may it not be the watchmen, Mṛcch.; मा भवन्तम् अनलः पवनो वा, may not fire or wind harm thee, Vām. v, 1, 14; esp. = not so, e.g. मा प्रातृद, not so, O Pr˚, ŚBr.; in this meaning also मा मा, मा मैवम्, मा तावत्)

in the Veda often with उ (मो॑) = and not, nor (e.g. मा॑ मघो॑नः प॑रि ख्यतम् मो॑ अस्मा॑कम् ऋ॑ष्णाम्, do not forget the rich lords nor us the poets, RV. v, 65, 6; and then usually followed by षु॑ = सु॑, e.g. मो षु॑ णः नि॑रृतिर् वधीत्, let not N˚ on any account destroy us, i, 38, 6)
in ŚBr. स्म मा — मो॑ स्म = neither — nor (in a prohibitive sense).

2. मा cl. 3. P. मि॑माति (accord. to Dhātup. xxv, 6 Ā. मिमीते; SV. मिमेति; Pot. मिमीयत्, Kāṭh.; pf., मिमाय; aor. अ॑मीमेत् Subj. मीमयत्; inf. मा॑तवै॑),
to sound, bellow, roar, bleat (esp. said of cows, calves, goats &c.), RV.; AV.; Br. :
Intens., only pr. p. मे॑म्यत्, bleating (as a goat), RV. i, 162, 2.
Vārtt. 2

Pat.),
to cause to be measured or built, measure, build, erect, Up.; GṛS.; MBh. &c.:
Desid. मित्सति, ˚ते, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 54; 58 (cf. निर्-√ मा) :
Intens. मेमीयते, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 66.

etym.s: [cf. Zd. mā; Gk. μέτρον, μετρέω; Lat. mētior, mensus, mensura; Slav. měra; Lith. mėrà.]

spans.s: 4. मा f. See under 4. म, p. 771, col. 2.
